title: Brazilian Chicken Skewers with Aromatic Flair
description: Grilled chicken skewers marinated in a zesty Brazilian-inspired mix of spices and herbs, served with a side of aromatic vegetables.

ingredients.name: Brazilian
ingredients.notes: such as chili powder and cumin

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together aromatic and Brazilian spice mixes, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Add chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with marinade.
Thread chicken and vegetables onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush skewers with remaining marinade and season with salt and pepper.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender.
Let skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
